Container.Name: MC-Router-UI
Container.Overview: Web UI for mc-router: Minecraft Reverse Proxy with Cloudflare DDNS, Crafty integration, and user management. Routes Minecraft connections to the correct backend server based on the hostname. NOTE: The image must be built locally before first use (see README).

Config.Name: Minecraft Port
Config.Description: Incoming Minecraft connections (SNI routing). This port must be accessible via port forwarding or DynDNS.

Config.Name: Web UI Port
Config.Description: Port for the web management interface (internally always 8000). Best operated behind Nginx Proxy Manager or a Cloudflare Tunnel.

Config.Name: Data Path
Config.Description: Storage location for the SQLite database and all persistent data. This path is preserved during updates.

Config.Name: Admin Username
Config.Description: Username of the admin account. Automatically created on first start. Changes only take effect after a restart.

Config.Name: Admin Password
Config.Description: Password of the admin account. PLEASE CHANGE THIS! It is compared with the stored hash on every start and updated if necessary.

Config.Name: Secret Key
Config.Description: Secret key for session cookies. Leave blank = automatically generated and permanently stored in the DB (recommended). Only set if you want to force a specific value.

Config.Name: Minecraft Ingress Port (Internal)
Config.Description: Internal Minecraft port that mc-router listens on. Must match the mapped container port.

Config.Name: mc-router API Port (Internal)
Config.Description: Internal REST API port of mc-router. Used only internally — do not map externally!

Config.Name: Cloudflare API Token
Config.Description: [Optional] Cloudflare API token with DNS:Edit permissions. If set, DNS A-records are automatically created when adding a route and updated upon IP changes.

Config.Name: Cloudflare Zone ID
Config.Description: [Optional] Cloudflare Zone ID (from the Cloudflare Dashboard). Specify either Zone ID OR Zone Name.

Config.Name: Cloudflare Zone Name
Config.Description: [Optional] Cloudflare Zone Name (e.g. my-domain.com). Alternative to Zone ID — resolved automatically.

Config.Name: DDNS Check Interval (Seconds)
Config.Description: [Optional] How often the public IP is checked for changes (in seconds). Default: 300 (5 minutes).

Config.Name: Crafty URL
Config.Description: [Optional] URL of your Crafty controller, e.g. https://crafty:8443. Must be in the same Docker network or reachable. Overrides the setting saved in the Web UI upon startup.

Config.Name: Crafty API Key
Config.Description: [Optional] API Key for your Crafty controller. Required if you want to edit server ports directly in Crafty.
